Michael, saw Recharge brought Skio aboard, now powering 20,000-plus merchants and over $20B in GMV.

A combination at that scale usually puts more in-market merchants in play than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Recharge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Michael, quick follow-up for Recharge.

After folding in Skio, the cross-sell and migration target usually outruns headcount. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Recharge needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Michael, last bit of proof for Recharge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Recharge's reply rate likely compares to other ecommerce software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
